title: transcripts/index.json
description: Metadata for every transcript under transcripts/ (Ingest spec 0010). Written by Sermon-Note-Ingest.

path.description: The transcript file. Load it as written; never build it.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file at path. null for a record with no stored hash.

audio_url.description: The enclosure URL the transcript at path was produced from. A feed can re-post an item with new audio, and the file at path stays the old audio's until Ingest re-transcribes it, so a consumer compares this against its own current enclosure before trusting the text. null when Ingest has no record of the source enclosure.
